output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Disney’s latest filed financial statements are its unaudited Q3 FY2026 Form 10-Q, filed August 5, 2026, for the quarter and nine months ended June 27, 2026. For the nine months, Disney reported $76.397 billion in revenue, $7.287 billion in net income attributable to Disney, $12.515 billion in cash provided by operations, and $204.740 billion in total assets; the quarter alone produced $25.248 billion in revenue and $2.638 billion in net income attributable to Disney. The latest audited annual statements remain the FY2025 Form 10-K, filed November 13, 2025, which reported $94.425 billion in revenue and $12.404 billion in net income attributable to Disney.
caveats: The Q3 FY2026 filing is an interim Form 10-Q and explicitly does not include all information and footnotes required for complete GAAP financial statements.
Disney announced that it would release fiscal Q4 and full-year 2026 results on November 17, 2026, so those statements were not yet available as of November 11, 2026.
